originalFamilyScopeSummary: Audit and optimize deposit flow friction for unfunded Extension trade-screen users converting at 4.8% vs Mobile's 12.4%
currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete: feat(perps): investigate and improve deposit conversion for unfunded trade-screen users
notes: Follow-up round on PR #45986. The funnel instrumentation (click -> deposit opened -> deposit confirmed -> trade after deposit) and the UI improvement (enabled Add funds to trade CTA, hint, labeled row control) are already on the branch. This round fixed one bugbot correctness defect in the funnel join: a repeat unfunded click after a confirmed deposit reset the confirmation, so the first post-deposit order was not attributed. The recipe passes on branch + origin/main. The post-launch conversion-lift AC cannot be verified pre-merge; this PR ships the instrumentation needed to measure it.
